Questions before you buy

Questions before you decide

Does this page process payments?

No. The static page links to the checkout target and keeps purchase processing outside the generated HTML.

What is the default checkout target?

The builder defaults all purchase CTAs to #checkout unless the blueprint provides another target.

Can I swap in approved page-kit blocks?

Yes. Approved partials can replace built-in sections while preserving OfferOS markers.

Does the hero stay stacked?

Yes. The hero keeps the locked stacked VSL shell and large 16:9 video frame markers.

Where does the proof appear?

Proof appears before the main offer stack so the sale is earned before the ask.

Can I use real assets later?

Yes. The builder uses intended asset paths even when the files are not present yet.

How is quality tracked?

The manifest receives sales-page artifact metadata and quality fields for later validation.
